deep_dive.title: What the Averages Hide: Monocular Metric Depth Models Still Fail in Everyday Scenes, Mostly on Scale
deep_dive.abstract: Zero-shot monocular metric depth models are evaluated by averaging metric and scale-aligned scores across datasets. Averages cannot show how many images still have severely wrong metric depth, whether depth is under- or overestimated, or whether different models fail on the same images. We propose an evaluation built on per-image results: the failure rate (metric $δ_1$ < 0.5); scale-aligned metrics for structure, and the bias, dispersion and absolute error of the alignment scale for scale; and a cross-model comparison that separates shared from model-specific failures. We apply it to 11 recent architectures with and without ground-truth intrinsics (18 model evaluations) on the 7 everyday-scene benchmarks (4,406 images) used by MoGe-2. Metric depth estimation is not solved in everyday scenes, and the remaining difficulty is mainly scale: the best of the 18 evaluations still has a failure rate of 7.7% (datasets weighted equally); pooled over all failures, 78.8% have intact structure, and after scale correction 98.3% no longer fail. Images failed by at least 6 architectures make up 7.3% of the data, concentrated on HAMMER and DIODE; even when selected only by architectures of other families, they hold 34% to 40% of the error of the top 6 models, against 14% to 18% for as many random images from the same datasets. Adding objects reduces the scale error of most models; ground-truth intrinsics and, in most families, larger models reduce the failures but do not remove them. We recommend reporting failure rates, structure and scale separately, and results stratified by how many models fail. We will release the code, the per-image results with shared-failure labels, and two diagnostic sets built from TUM RGB-D.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: Shows that averaged metrics hide failures of zero-shot monocular metric depth models, proposing per-image failure-rate, scale-bias and cross-model analysis over 11 architectures and 7 benchmarks.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 该文指出零样本单目度量深度模型通常以数据集平均指标评估，掩盖了仍存在严重深度错误的图像比例、深度高估或低估方向以及模型间失败是否重合。作者提出基于逐图结果的评估方案，包含度量失败率、结构对齐指标以及对齐尺度的偏差、离散度和绝对误差，并进行跨模型失败对比。在7个日常场景基准、4406张图像上评估11种架构共18次模型评测，发现失败主要集中在尺度上。该工作揭示了平均指标的盲区，为深度基础模型的真实场景可靠性评估提供了更细粒度的工具。
